manifestNumber.description: Unique external identifier of the manifest

status.description: Current status of the manifest. Values include PENDING, LOADING, CLOSED, DISPATCHED, DEPARTED ORIGIN, ARRIVED DESTINATION, SPOTTED, UNLOADING, and COMPLETED. Any other status given will be ingested as "OTHER: {status}"

trailerNumber.description: Unique external identifier for the trailer associated to the manifest

originLocationCode.description: Unique external identifier for the origin location of the manifest

originDoorNumber.description: Unique external identifier for the origin door of the manifest

destinationLocationCode.description: Unique external identifier for the origin location of the manifest

nextLocationCode.description: Unique external identifier for the next intermediate terminal location on the manifest

currentLocationCode.description: Unique external identifier for the current terminal location

destinationDoorNumber.description: Unique external identifier for the origin door of the manifest

plannedCloseTime.description: Timestamp for the planned close time in UTC. ISO8601 format

actualArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the actual arrival time in UTC. ISO8601 format.

nextActualArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the next actual arrival time in UTC. ISO8601 format

nextEstimatedArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the next estimated arrival time in UTC. ISO8601 format

plannedArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the planned arrival time in UTC. ISO8601 format

nextPlannedArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the next planned arrival time in UTC. ISO8601 format

estimatedArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the estimated arrival time in UTC. ISO8601 format

associatedProNumbers.description: An array of PRO numbers associated with the manifest

associatedTripNumbers.description: An array of unique external trip identifiers associated with the manifest

externalTripId.description: Unique external identifier of the linehaul trip

status.description: Status of the linehaul trip. Values include pending, started, departedOrigin, arrivedDestination, completed

driverCode.description: An array of driver codes associated with the linehaul trip. A driver code needs to exist in Maven

vehicleNumber.description: External identifier for the vehicle associated with the linehaul trip

manifestNumbers.description: An array of manifest numbers associated with the linehaul trip. A manifest number needs to exist in Maven

plannedStartTime.description: Timestamp for the planned start time from the origin in UTC. ISO8601 format

plannedArrivalTime.description: Timestamp for the planned arrival time to the destination in UTC. ISO8601 format

originLocationCode.description: External identifier for the origin location of the linehaul trip. Location needs to exist in Maven

destinationLocationCode.description: External identifier for the destination location of the linehaul trip. Location needs to exist in Maven

instructions.description: Used to provide additional instructions to the drivers for the linehaul trip
instructions.example: Please make sure to allow for extra time due to highway construction

attributes.description: Additional custom properties of the linehaul trip

post.description: Enables the creation and updating (upsert) of a linehaul manifest.

400.description: When a request to upload a linehaul manifest fails due to wrong client input

post.description: Enables the creation and updating (upsert) of a linehaul trip.

400.description: When a request to upload a linehaul trip fails due to wrong client input

500.description: Unknown error response from the rest-service.
